level.player_weapon: Plasma Wrench (modded with a neural feedback circuit)

encounters.location: Derelict Server Farm - Lower Access Shaft

enemy.name: Sentient Maintenance Drone
enemy.weakness: Neural Feedback Circuit (player's weapon mod)

encounters.hazard: Electrical Surges from unstable power grid

pickup.name: Cryo-Cell Capacitor
pickup.effect: Temporary shield for 10 seconds (can be used once)

encounters.trigger: After defeating the drone, the server farm's security system begins to override, triggering a lockdown and activating the next encounter.

encounters.location: Mainframe Access Terminal - Data Core Room

enemy.name: Hacker Ghost
enemy.weakness: Cryo-Cell Capacitor (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Data corruption causing hallucinations and system malfunctions

pickup.name: Neuro-Injector (Pheromone Pack)
pickup.effect: Pheromone-based distraction for 15 seconds, useful in combat

encounters.trigger: The Hacker Ghost attempts to upload a virus, causing the mainframe to crash and reboot. The system then triggers a lockdown on the upper levels, leading to the final boss fight.

enemy.name: System Overlord (Boss)
enemy.weakness: Neuro-Injector (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Overloading the mainframe could cause a city-wide blackout

pickup.name: Cybercore Relic
pickup.effect: Permanent +25% damage to plasma weapons

encounters.trigger: System Overlord begins its final data purge, triggering a countdown before the city's AI system collapses. The player must choose: fight or flee with the relic.

boss.name: System Overlord
boss.weakness: Neuro-Injector (pharmaceutical distraction) - temporarily disables the AI's sensory systems for 10 seconds
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Overlord's core before the city's AI system fully collapses

level.objective: Infiltrate the system core and destroy the System Overlord to prevent the AI from taking over Neo-Tokyo.
level.reward: Cybercore Relic (boosts plasma weapon damage permanently)

level.setting: Neon-drenched underbelly of Neo-Tokyo, 2147. The city pulses with synthetic life, flickering holograms, and the ever-present hum of drones and gunfire.

enemy.name: Holographic Doppelganger
enemy.weakness: Nano-Needle Injector (Pierces the illusion with physical damage)

encounters.hazard: Glitching holograms cause disorientation and 15% accuracy penalty.

pickup.name: Neuro-Link Crystal
pickup.effect: Reveals enemy weaknesses for 30 seconds.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Doppelganger, the hologram collapses, revealing a hidden security code. A nearby terminal activates, sending a signal to the next location.

enemy.name: Cybernetic Janitor
enemy.weakness: Neuro-Link Crystal (Reveals hidden AI core vulnerable to physical strikes)

encounters.hazard: Toxic fumes and collapsing steel beams create environmental damage.

pickup.name: Phase Disruptor Core
pickup.effect: Disrupts enemy targeting systems, allowing 30% damage bypass for the next 60 seconds.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Janitor, the pipeline collapses, revealing a hidden passage leading directly to the boss arena.

enemy.name: The Architect
enemy.weakness: Phase Disruptor Core (Disables the Architect's energy shield, making it vulnerable to direct strikes)

encounters.hazard: The Architect summons drones and firewalls that attack the player directly.

pickup.name: System Override Key
pickup.effect: One-time use to disable the Architect's core for 15 seconds.

encounters.trigger: After the Architect is defeated, the city's main AI goes offline, revealing the truth behind the chaos.

boss.name: The Architect
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Architect with the Phase Disruptor Core active to disable its shield.

level.objective: Infiltrate the data vault, survive the pipeline, and dismantle the Architect's control over the city.
level.reward: Access to the mainframe, unlocking a new cybernetic upgrade and a data shard containing classified info.

level.setting: A derelict cyberpunk district known for its ghostly neon lights and hidden data vaults. The air is thick with fog, and the hum of corrupted AI echoes through the ruins. Players navigate a labyrinth of forgotten tech and rogue AI.
level.player_weapon: Lumen Core (A glowing plasma weapon that can overload circuits and short-circuit machinery)

enemy.name: Scramble Drone
enemy.weakness: Lumen Core (overloads the drone's circuits, causing it to short out and explode)

encounters.hazard: Data static interferes with vision and disrupts communication

pickup.name: Corrupted Data Chip
pickup.effect: Reveals hidden enemy locations on the map for the next encounter

encounters.trigger: After defeating the drone, the corrupted data chip activates a hidden security door leading upwards.

enemy.name: Rogue Synth
enemy.weakness: Corrupted Data Chip (when used, the chip can overload the synth's neural matrix, causing temporary paralysis)

encounters.hazard: Pulsing energy fields that occasionally disrupt movement

pickup.name: Nano-Forged Circuit
pickup.effect: Grants a temporary shield that absorbs 25% of incoming damage

encounters.trigger: After the fight, the synth collapses into a pile of broken circuits, revealing a hidden passage leading to the top of the Data Spire.

enemy.name: The Neon Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Nano-Forged Circuit (when activated, it bypasses the Sentinel's AI defenses and allows the Lumen Core to critically overload its core)

encounters.hazard: The Sentinel's AI controls the environment, activating traps and shifting the structure

pickup.name: Echo Core
pickup.effect: Unlocks a powerful passive ability that allows the player to temporarily manipulate nearby tech

encounters.trigger: The Sentinel emerges from the ruins, guarding the final data vault. Only by using the Nano-Forged Circuit and Lumen Core in sequence can the player defeat it.

boss.name: The Neon Sentinel
boss.weakness: Nano-Forged Circuit (when activated, it bypasses the Sentinel's AI defenses and allows the Lumen Core to critically overload its core)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Sentinel by using the Nano-Forged Circuit to disable its core defenses and then using the Lumen Core to overload it

level.objective: Retrieve the Echo Core from the Data Spire's summit. The Echo Core is a key to unlocking a secure AI network that has been corrupted by rogue programming.
level.reward: Echo Core and a blueprint for a new upgrade for the Lumen Core.

level.setting: A decaying, neon-drenched cyberpunk district called Neonvein, where time seems to loop endlessly. The player, a Chronomancer, must navigate a labyrinth of fractured time to escape the past and break the cycle.
level.player_weapon: Chrono-Bolt: A temporal energy weapon that fires bolts of time energy, capable of freezing enemies in time or damaging them with time echoes.

enemy.name: Temporal Drone (Echo-1)
enemy.weakness: Chrono-Bolt (time freeze)

encounters.hazard: The plaza is filled with flickering time echoes that slow the player's perception.

pickup.name: Chrono Core Fragment
pickup.effect: Increases Chrono-Bolt damage by 15% for the next encounter.

encounters.trigger: Defeating Echo-1 unlocks a hidden time gate that leads to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Mimic-3 (Temporal Clone)
enemy.weakness: Chrono Core Fragment (increased damage)

encounters.hazard: The environment shifts between past and present, confusing the player's perception of reality.

pickup.name: Stabilizer Chip
pickup.effect: Reduces time distortions by 50%, improving player movement and accuracy.

encounters.trigger: Destroying Mimic-3 causes the ground to collapse, revealing a hidden chamber beneath the plaza.

encounters.location: Echo Plaza - The Time Core Chamber

enemy.name: Echo Lord
enemy.weakness: Stabilizer Chip (reduces time distortion, allowing Chrono-Bolt to land critical hits)

encounters.hazard: The chamber is filled with swirling time vortexes that can trap the player in time loops.

pickup.name: Time Anchor
pickup.effect: Permanently increases Chrono-Bolt damage and allows the player to escape time loops.

encounters.trigger: Defeating Echo Lord stabilizes the time flow, allowing the player to escape the Echo Corridor.

boss.name: Echo Lord
boss.weakness: Stabilizer Chip (allows Chrono-Bolt to land critical hits by reducing time distortions)
boss.victory_condition: Defeating Echo Lord ends the loop and allows the player to progress beyond the Echo Corridor.

level.objective: Break the time loop by defeating Echo Lord using the pickups and weapons acquired from prior encounters.
level.reward: Time Anchor - Permanently increases the power of the Chrono-Bolt and grants immunity to time loops for the duration of the level.

level.setting: A decaying, neon-drenched district known as 'The Glitch Quarter'—a place where the digital and the physical are in constant conflict.
level.player_weapon: Nano-Synthesis Injector (a custom alchemical weapon that can transmute materials into volatile compounds)

enemy.name: Synthetic Warden
enemy.weakness: Nanoglass Coating (can be dissolved by the player’s Nano-Synthesis Injector if used with a specific alchemical catalyst)

encounters.hazard: Data Static (random debuffs like reduced accuracy or increased damage taken)

pickup.name: Catalyst Core X-7
pickup.effect: When combined with the Nano-Synthesis Injector, increases its potency against synthetic enemies by 50%

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Warden, a corrupted data stream activates, revealing a hidden access point leading to the next encounter.

encounters.location: The Biomech Nest (Rats and Mutants Infestation)

enemy.name: Flesh Augmented Rat King
enemy.weakness: Organic Flesh (vulnerable to the player’s alchemical poisons, particularly the Catalyst Core X-7 if used as a projectile)

encounters.hazard: Mutagen Mist (slowly mutates the player, increasing damage output but also reducing health)

pickup.name: Neural Link Residue
pickup.effect: When used with the Nano-Synthesis Injector, allows the player to bypass the AI defenses of the final boss.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Rat King, the mutagen mist coalesces into a signal, guiding the player toward the final confrontation.

enemy.name: AI Godhead: ECHO-9
enemy.weakness: Neural Link Residue (when injected into the AI’s core, it causes a system-wide overload and temporary paralysis)

encounters.hazard: System Overload (periodic energy bursts that reduce player movement speed and damage)

pickup.name: Overclocked Core (boss reward)
pickup.effect: When installed in the player’s Injector, allows it to fire elemental compounds at 2x speed for 15 seconds

encounters.trigger: Defeat the AI Godhead to unlock the final pickup, but only if the player has the Neural Link Residue and used it correctly in the fight.

boss.name: AI Godhead: ECHO-9
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss using the Neural Link Residue obtained from the second encounter.

level.objective: Navigate the Glitch Quarter, defeat the three enemies, and use the pickups to overcome the AI Godhead and escape with the Overclocked Core.
level.reward: Overclocked Core (enhanced Injector ability), experience points, and access to a new alchemical recipe.

level.player_weapon: Neural Lasso (a neuro-impulse weapon that disrupts enemy AI)

enemy.name: Ghost Warden
enemy.weakness: Neural Lasso (disrupts its AI, causing 50% damage increase)

encounters.hazard: Flickering holographic traps that trigger on movement

pickup.name: Neuro-Transmitter Chip
pickup.effect: Unlocks a hidden path to the second encounter

encounters.trigger: After defeating Ghost Warden, the Neuro-Transmitter Chip activates a hidden door to the next level.

enemy.name: Cybernetic Janitor
enemy.weakness: Neuro-Transmitter Chip (when used in conjunction with Neural Lasso, causes a 30% damage boost)

encounters.hazard: Puddles of toxic runoff that slow the player

pickup.name: Cryo-Injector
pickup.effect: Freezes enemies on contact for 3 seconds

encounters.trigger: After defeating Cybernetic Janitor, the Cryo-Injector unlocks a hidden maintenance hatch leading to the final boss.

enemy.name: The Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Cryo-Injector (freezes The Sentinel in place, allowing the Neural Lasso to do maximum damage)

encounters.hazard: Radiation storms that damage the player over time

pickup.name: System Overload Core
pickup.effect: Optional: Explodes for massive damage if the player chooses to use it as a last resort.

encounters.trigger: After surviving the hazards and defeating The Sentinel, the player is given a choice: destroy the Overload Core and escape, or face a final, optional boss encounter.

boss.name: The Architect
boss.weakness: Cryo-Injector (freezes The Architect for 5 seconds, allowing a 100% damage boost from the Neural Lasso)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat The Architect and escape the collapsing facility.

level.objective: Survive the desolate cyberpunk ruins, retrieve key items, and defeat The Architect to escape with the data core.
level.reward: Data Core containing encrypted files of the corporation's AI project.

level.setting: A flooded cyberpunk alleyway in the heart of Neon Tokyo. Pulsing with neon lights, rain falls in slow motion, and the air is filled with the hum of distant hovercars and the distant wail of a synth-siren.
level.player_weapon: Stormcaller's Thunderclaw (a handheld lightning cannon with a built-in capacitor that can be charged by collecting lightning tokens)

enemy.name: Whispering Drone
enemy.weakness: Lightning Tokens (collected from prior encounters)

encounters.hazard: The ground is slippery from rain, and the drone's sonic pulse causes the player to lose balance if not careful.

pickup.name: Lightning Token
pickup.effect: Charges the player's Thunderclaw by 25%.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Whispering Drone, a nearby neon sign flickers and a voice says, 'The storm is coming...'

encounters.location: Broken Circuit Station (Encounter 2: The Corrupted Tinker)

enemy.name: Corrupted Tinker
enemy.weakness: The Lightning Token (from the previous encounter)

encounters.hazard: The tinker is surrounded by a web of live wires. Touching them causes a minor electric shock, reducing player health by 5.

pickup.name: Storm Core
pickup.effect: Increases the Thunderclaw's damage by 15 for the next 3 encounters.

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Corrupted Tinker, a nearby door opens with a mechanical hiss, revealing a path to the final confrontation.

encounters.location: The Storm Citadel (Final Encounter: The Storm King)

enemy.name: Storm King
enemy.weakness: The Storm Core (acquired in Encounter 2)

encounters.hazard: The Storm King summons lightning strikes and creates localized electrical storms. The player must dodge or be stunned.

pickup.name: Stormcaller's Crest
pickup.effect: Unlocks a unique ability: 'Tempest Call' — a powerful lightning blast that can stun the enemy.

encounters.trigger: The Storm King emerges from the storm, his eyes glowing with crackling energy, and declares, 'You’ve come for the storm, but can you command it?'

boss.name: Storm King
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Storm King using the Storm Core to break his lightning shield.

level.objective: Navigate the neon-soaked alleyways, defeat three foes, collect powerful pickups, and master the power of the storm to defeat the Storm King.
level.reward: Stormcaller's Crest — granting the player the ability to command the storm with precision, and a new title: 'Tempest Tamer.'

level.setting: A forgotten corner of Neo-Tokyo, where neon lights flicker over moss-covered concrete and data streams whisper through the air. The city sleeps, and only the player's power can awaken the secrets buried beneath the silence.
level.player_weapon: Terra Wave - A geomancer's signature spell that manipulates the earth, creating shockwaves, pillars of stone, and destabilizing the ground.

enemy.name: Cyber-Root
enemy.weakness: Terra Wave

encounters.hazard: A corrupted data core pulses with static energy. The player must bypass it to progress, but the core is protected by a single Cyber-Root bot.

pickup.name: Stabilized Silicon Core
pickup.effect: Increases the player's geomancy range by 15%

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Cyber-Root, the data core powers down, revealing a hidden path to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Moss Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Stabilized Silicon Core

encounters.hazard: A garden of overgrown machinery and biotech vines. The player must navigate the maze while avoiding the Moss Sentinel, a fusion of plant and AI.

pickup.name: Echo Crystal
pickup.effect: When used, it reveals hidden paths or enemy weaknesses.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Moss Sentinel, the Echo Crystal hums with energy, drawing the attention of the final, more powerful enemy.

enemy.name: Archon-Root
enemy.weakness: Echo Crystal

encounters.hazard: A massive, crystalline structure that pulses with a slow, hypnotic rhythm. It is the heart of the forgotten AI, now corrupted by the city’s decay.

pickup.name: Serenity Core
pickup.effect: Grants the player a temporary shield and restores 30% of health.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Archon-Root, the player gains access to the Serenity Core, restoring balance to the area and ending the level in a peaceful stillness.

boss.name: The Dreaming Nexus (Archon-Root)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the crystalline core using the Echo Crystal, causing the Nexus to shatter into harmless data shards.

level.objective: Navigate the forgotten corners of the city, using geomantic abilities to overcome corrupted AI and biotech threats, and restore balance to the sleeping world.
level.reward: Serenity Core – a powerful relic that allows the player to create temporary safe zones and shield against environmental hazards.
